observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== pg_stat_activity: app connections ==="
docker exec -i sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -t -c "SELECT usename, count(*), state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='sva_studio' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY usename, state;" 2>&1
echo "=== test exact getTaskDetails insert as REAL sva_job_worker ==="
docker exec -i sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva_job_worker -d sva_studio -c "insert into graphile_worker._private_tasks as tasks (identifier) select unnest(array['studio-job-executor','plugin-tenant-lifecycle-retry','studio-job-executor-privileged']::text[]) on conflict do nothing;" 2>&1 | head
